verdict.rationale: The firm runs free public blogs, including India Corporate Law, described as sharing legal developments in a 'user-friendly manner', and it publishes explainer articles such as one on the DPDP Rules. The public Prarambh FAQs exist but cover the incubator programme (cohort length, eligibility, mentorship), not startup legal topics. Nothing shows a startup-oriented knowledge base on formation, financing or equity. Missing for 10: startup-specific guides on company formation, plain-language financing and fundraising explainers, equity and ESOP FAQs, and a dedicated founder resource hub.
